item.ourlet.spatial_needle.tip1: Right-click two block faces to sew them together.
item.ourlet.spatial_needle.tip2: Whatever touches one face comes out of the other.
item.ourlet.spatial_needle.tip3: Sneak + right-click a seam to unpick it.
ourlet.needle.first: First stitch tacked. Now pick the other face.
ourlet.needle.sewn: Fold sewn: %s blocks folded into a seam.
ourlet.needle.already: This face is already sewn. Sneak to unpick it.
ourlet.needle.not_solid: The needle needs a solid face to bite into.
ourlet.needle.too_many: You can keep at most %s folds sewn.
ourlet.relay.nothing: Nothing within reach on the other side.
ourlet.relay.unbreakable: The thread can't tear that block out.
item.ourlet.thimble.tip1: Sneak + right-click a face: that's home.
item.ourlet.thimble.tip2: Right-click anywhere: a pocket fold to home opens for 20 seconds.
ourlet.thimble.no_home: No home yet: sneak + right-click a face with the thimble.
ourlet.thimble.home_lost: Home is gone: the block was changed.
ourlet.thimble.home_busy: Home is already sewn by another fold.
ourlet.shears.one_way: One-way fold: you can only go in through this face.
ourlet.shears.closed: Fold closed. Snip again to reopen.
ourlet.carnet.title: Sewing Notebook
ourlet.carnet.hold: Hold [%s] to leaf through the notebook
ourlet.carnet.sew.1: Any solid face of any block can be sewn. No special block needed.
ourlet.carnet.sew.2: Right-click a face with the Spatial Needle: the first stitch is tacked.
ourlet.carnet.sew.3: Right-click another face, 3 or 5,000 blocks away: both faces are now sewn together.
ourlet.carnet.sew.4: Both ends wear the same thread color, so you always know which seams belong together.
ourlet.carnet.sew.5: Sneak + right-click a seam with the needle to unpick it. If a sewn block disappears, the fold tears.
ourlet.carnet.pass.1: Whatever touches one face comes out of the other: items, mobs, players, arrows...
ourlet.carnet.pass.2: Speed is kept and turned with the face: falling into a floor seam throws you sideways out of the wall.
ourlet.carnet.pass.3: It works both ways. An arrow shot into the wall flies up out of the floor.
ourlet.carnet.pass.4: Both ends stay loaded: whatever goes in arrives instantly, even far away.
ourlet.carnet.piston.1: A piston pushes a row of blocks towards a sewn face...
ourlet.carnet.piston.2: ...the block in front is pulled into the fold...
ourlet.carnet.piston.3: ...and comes out in front of the other face. If that spot is blocked, the piston stalls.
ourlet.carnet.relay.1: Your gaze goes through the seam and carries on from the other face.
ourlet.carnet.relay.2: Mine the sewn wall: the block you see on the other side gives way, as fast as its own hardness allows.
ourlet.carnet.relay.3: The wall never breaks, and the drops come back to you through the thread.
ourlet.carnet.relay.4: Right-click the seam to use what you hold over there: place a torch, flip a lever, plant a sapling.
ourlet.carnet.relay.5: Mine a sewn block on any other face to remove it (and tear the fold).
ourlet.carnet.thimble.1: Sneak + right-click a face with the Thimble: this face becomes home.
ourlet.carnet.thimble.2: Far away, even in another dimension, right-click any face: it is basted to home.
ourlet.carnet.thimble.3: Step in, or throw your loot in: it comes out at home.
ourlet.carnet.thimble.4: The basting thread comes undone after 20 seconds. Only one pocket fold at a time.
ourlet.carnet.control.1: Right-click a seam with shears to change how the fold works.
ourlet.carnet.control.2: First snip: one-way. You can only go in through the face you snipped. The other seam shrinks.
ourlet.carnet.control.3: Second snip: closed. The seams pull tight and nothing gets through. Third snip: open again.
ourlet.carnet.control.4: A redstone signal next to either sewn block also closes the fold, like a door.
ourlet.carnet.control.5: Sorting, airlocks, traps: a fold behaves like part of your redstone build.
ourlet.carnet.dimensions.1: The thread crosses dimensions: tack the first stitch in the Overworld...
ourlet.carnet.dimensions.2: ...sew the second one in the Nether or the End. Everything goes through, both ways.
ourlet.carnet.dimensions.3: Both ends stay loaded on both sides. No portal frame, no loading screen.

item.ourlet.spatial_needle.tip4: With a Spool in the other hand: a large 3×3 seam.
ourlet.needle.first_patch: First 3×3 patch tacked. Now pick the other wall.
ourlet.needle.patch_space: A 3×3 seam needs a flat, solid, unsewn 3×3 surface here.
ourlet.tension.elastic: Elastic thread: whatever comes out is thrown harder.
ourlet.tension.damped: Waxed thread: whatever comes out barely moves.

ourlet.carnet.patchwork.1: Hold a Spool in your other hand while you sew: the needle sews a large 3×3 seam.
ourlet.carnet.patchwork.2: The other side needs a flat 3×3 surface too. A large seam costs 3 uses of the needle.
ourlet.carnet.patchwork.3: Big enough for horses, boats and minecarts. Each of the 9 squares leads to its twin.
ourlet.carnet.dyes.1: Right-click a seam with any dye: both ends of the fold take the new color.
ourlet.carnet.dyes.2: Rename a fold with a named name tag: the name shows when you aim at the seam, and when you arrive.
ourlet.carnet.dyes.3: Colors and names never change how a fold works. They help you find your way.
ourlet.carnet.tension.1: A slime ball on a seam makes the thread elastic: whatever comes out is thrown 1.5 times faster.
ourlet.carnet.tension.2: Honeycomb waxes the thread: whatever comes out barely moves. Use the same item again to undo it.
ourlet.carnet.tension.3: Wax a ceiling seam sewn to the floor below: an endless, gentle fall.
ourlet.carnet.hoppers.1: A hopper pointing into a sewn block pours its items through the fold...
ourlet.carnet.hoppers.2: ...and if a chest, barrel or hopper touches the other seam, the items go straight in.
ourlet.carnet.hoppers.3: No container on the other side? The items are thrown out. A full chest makes the hopper wait.
